issue_request: FHIR-47871 is an Applied/Persuasive OO technical correction for FHIR-core Device requesting replacement of "Equipment and supplies that provides..." with "Equipment and supplies that provide...".

OO HCP minutes list FHIR-47871 as a Device typo to fix and later include it among bulk technical-correction vote items. No relevant Zulip or Confluence full-text search result contradicted the Jira/source conclusion.
